## Summary

Describe what changed and why it is useful.

## Verification

List the exact checks you ran and their results. For ink or input changes, name the device and platform.

## Visual evidence

Add screenshots or a recording for visible changes. Remove this section when it does not apply.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request is focused on one coherent change.
- [ ] Behaviour and saved data stay identical across platforms; platform-specific code stays in the shell.
- [ ] Tests cover new logic and regression paths where practical.
- [ ] `.grapho` files written by older versions still open, and `docs/file-format.md` is updated when the format changes.
- [ ] Any latency or performance claim carries a proof of correct output from the same run.
- [ ] I have read the contributing guide and have the right to submit this work under the project license.
